notes.title: What Bytebond Isn't
notes.content: [h2]As we get ready to launch Bytebond, we want to take a moment to share what our game isn’t—so you know exactly what to expect, and can enjoy it for what it is![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/685ac4de597a81264ad790af23b75168e816d74b.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]First and foremost, Bytebond isn’t a massive, open-world game.[/b] [/h3][p]Our game is the result of what we can call now a small indie team. Bytebond was born during one of the game jams, when we were still studying at the university. What started as a quick project of a handful of students became a game we're proud of. We made something awesome without a huge studio or a big budget behind us. Digestible when it comes to size, yet fun regardless of the limitations.[/p][h3][b]You won’t find lengthy dialogues or deep world-building here.[/b][/h3][p]In fact, there are no dialogues at all. This was a conscious choice, making Bytebond more universal and accessible, and letting the gameplay and visuals do the talking. [/p][p]The split-screen co-op might remind you of the old-school Lego games, but let’s be clear: we’re not nearly big enough to be using any famous franchises (Disney, please don’t come for us!). [/p][h3][b]Bytebond is not [i]Split Fiction[/i], and it’s not [i]It Takes Two[/i].[/b][/h3][p]If you’re looking for something on that scale, you might want to check out those titles instead. Instead, Bytebond is closer in spirit to games like Biped, Phogs, or Unravel 2. It’s a smaller, more intimate experience—definitely not AAA, and not pretending to be. But that also means it’s much more affordable, and we’ve poured our hearts into making it as fun and charming as possible.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/5393179bb3680d33dd4c5e073971b62a2da5efb9.gif"][/img][/p][h2][b]So, what IS Bytebond?[/b][/h2][p]Bytebond is a co-op game for two players, playable both locally and online. It’s all about working together to solve puzzles that get trickier as you progress, exploring different biomes (each with their own unique mechanics and art style) inside a quirky PC world. You can probably finish the game in 5-6 hours, making it a perfect choice for a cozy weekend or a fun evening with a friend.[/p][p]Most importantly, Bytebond is about sharing quality time. Whether you’re playing with a friend, partner, sibling, or child, we hope Bytebond gives you a chance to laugh, collaborate, and create memories together.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="DTW2QhTggiI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We can’t wait for you to play, and we hope you love Bytebond for what it is—a small, heartfelt adventure made with a lot of love.[/p][p]Until next time [/p][p][b]Bleep & Bloop OUT! ⚡[/b]  [/p][p]───────────────────────────────────────────── [/p][h3]⚡Add Bytebond to your Steam Wishlist⚡[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952690/Bytebond/"][/dynamiclink]───────────────────────────────────────────── [/p][h3]⚡Previous update⚡[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1952690/view/539989391348597713"][/dynamiclink]───────────────────────────────────────────── [/p][h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/AnsharPublishing"][b]🤖 Follow Anshar Publishing on Steam 🤖[/b][/url][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/b21c7265c478a6bdbbfdcb69f1a35d7d19364cdc.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Community Q&A Session
notes.content:
[h2]With the release of Bytebond just around the corner on September 18, we’re buzzing with excitement and gratitude for all the support you’ve shown us. [/h2][p]To celebrate, we’ve gathered your questions from social media and Discord, and today, our development team is here to answer them! We hope this Q&A gives you a peek behind the scenes and helps you get to know the small, but passionate team bringing Bytebond to life 😊[/p][p][/p][h3]🤖 How did it all start?[/h3][p][b]It all started in 2021[/b] as a group project on Lodz University of Technology in Poland. We started working together as a small team as a part of our studies. Little did we know that our little side project will soon turn into a full-blown game.[/p][p][/p][h3]🤖 How many people actually work on developing the game?[/h3][p][b]Our core team consists of 7 people.[/b] They constantly work on developing and improving the game, but we also collaborated with a few awesome freelancers to create the UI, art and music. And of course there is also the amazing Anshar Publishing and Anshar Studios team helping us along the way ❤️[/p][p][/p][h3]🤖 What inspired the concept for Bytebond?[/h3][p]I think the first impulse was to create a couch co-op game just because [b]we really like this genre[/b] and thought there isn’t enough of them out there. Apart from this, [b]Portal[/b] and [b]Transistor[/b] were our main inspirations. [/p][p][/p][h3]🤖 For how long have you been developing Bytebond?[/h3][p][b]The first prototype was created in April 2021[/b], since then more regular development started in the September of the same year and lasted ever since. As the game was created entirely in our free time after work, the development was slow, but consistent 💪[/p][p][/p][h3]🤖 Did you encounter any challenges while developing the game? How did you overcome them?[/h3][p]There were many challenges, just like with any big project, but to pinpoint the biggest ones: network multiplayer and difficulty balance.[/p][p]When starting the project, we didn’t assume that networking would be necessary, and back then no one in our team was capable of writing netcode. [b]Learning how to write a networked game while retrofitting existing mechanics with multiplayer support was the biggest challenge our team faced.[/b][/p][p][b]The difficulty is always a very hard factor in puzzle games.[/b] If the game is too easy, it becomes boring, if it’s too hard, it becomes frustrating. And the margin for error is much thinner than in other game genres. We did a lot of playtesting sessions to determine the right balance for the puzzles and iterated on every level design to maximize the chance of hitting the difficulty curve just right for most players.[/p][h3]
🤖 What’s your favorite location in Bytebond?[/h3][p]My answer would be totally different in earlier development, but after last months I've become deeply attached to [b]CPU, Motherboard and Credits[/b], as that's where a lot of love was put in![/p][h3][/h3][h3]🤖 What’s your favourite enemy design?[/h3][p][b]The other person I play with 😈[/b] There is no greater enemy than the hardships of collaboration. But on a serious note - [b]the jumping guy[/b] is a very unique concept, and we really like how he turned out.[/p][p][/p][h3]🤖 What's up with those old PCs? I thought we were inside the computer [/h3][p]They are just an infinite recursion loop, nothing to see here 👀[/p][p][/p][h3]🤖 Can you share any behind-the-scenes art or concept sketches?[/h3][p]We didn’t really have much in terms of concept art, as our team is small and has no concept artist, but I can show you [b]some screenshots of the game in its early stages[/b]![/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/8c2096183903ca56e74c7510d6c6ae9bfd70c3f9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/06b53ebc31f70de72fa2f9fe02c4ffdf1ff71d73.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/52a4a33d938fedd1a9979e6e4259f968b46ae077.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/144043e228985fe3ea32feaa35a8745f5411be44.png"][/img][/carousel][h3]🤖 How do you test and balance new updates before releasing them?[/h3][p]We first send the build to playtesters and gather the feedback, then the designers decide which changes are the most important and the rest of the team gets to implementing them.[/p][p][/p][h3]🤖 What’s the funniest bug or glitch you’ve encountered during development?[/h3][p]Don't even ask how that happened… [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/f1c610d904c9bef9ac91840c5fc34e05dc543d43.gif"][/img][/p][h3]🤖 Why are there animals inside the computer?[/h3][p][b]We wanted to show the PC as a kind of ecosystem with its own fauna.[/b] This is our way of interpreting what happens in the silicon and how the “bugs” are created 😁[/p][p] [/p][h3]🤖 What’s the biggest lesson you’ve learned while working on Bytebond?[/h3][p][b]That making a game from start to finish is extremely hard, but also very fun and rewarding.[/b] And that there is no better feeling than watching someone play your game and genuinely enjoy it. Also, that last months of development can change sooo much in how the game looks![/p][p][/p][h3]🤖 What advice would you give to someone who wants to get into game development?[/h3][p][b]Persistence, passion and lots of critical thinking are the most important.[/b] Gamedev is hard even if it doesn’t seem like it at first, and you must have lots of motivation to keep moving forward. But if you do, the sky is the limit, and you can find lots of fulfillment in it.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for joining us and for sending in your fantastic questions! [/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates as we count down to launch day—[b]September 18[/b]!
[/p][p]Until next time [/p][p][b]Bleep & Bloop OUT! ⚡[/b]  [/p][p]───────────────────────────────────────────── [/p][h3]⚡Add Bytebond to your Steam Wishlist⚡[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952690/Bytebond/"][/dynamiclink]───────────────────────────────────────────── [/p][h3]⚡Previous update⚡[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1952690/view/539989391348597283"][/dynamiclink]───────────────────────────────────────────── [/p][h3][b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/AnsharPublishing"]🤖 Follow Anshar Publishing on Steam 🤖[/url][/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/b21c7265c478a6bdbbfdcb69f1a35d7d19364cdc.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Journey Through Six Unique Biomes
notes.content: [h2]In Bytebond, every adventure begins with a spark—two brave robots, a looming virus, and a mission to save the core of a computer.[/h2][p][/p][p]But this isn’t just any rescue operation. As you journey deeper into the digital world, you’ll traverse six distinct biomes, each inspired by a different computer component and packed with its own unique challenges and mechanics.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="DTW2QhTggiI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]1. Flash Drive: The Starting Point[/h3][p]Your journey kicks off in the Flash Drive, where our robotic heroes awaken as the antivirus is being downloaded. This is where you’ll learn the basics, get your mission, and set out on your quest.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/ea9b4902f303f6bd5a2143d8d1d0a321f6857989.png"][/img][/p][h3]2. Cooling System: Stay Cool Under Pressure[/h3][p]Next, you’ll venture into the Cooling System. Here, things get a little chilly—and a lot more interesting! This biome introduces new mechanics that will test your coordination. Can you keep your cool as you navigate frosty obstacles and slippery surfaces?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/20dd76b37fe631520dbeb37bec8302dce936a88a.png"][/img][/p][h3]3. Sound Card: Feel the Rhythm[/h3][p]The Sound Card biome is where things start to groove. With vibrant visuals and audio-based mechanics, you’ll need to think a bit out of the boom-box. It’s a level that’s sure to get your circuits buzzing and your feet tapping![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/cd7d355706ba7ceeaa5fe7f207a6c4cf425865fe.png"][/img][/p][h3]4. CD-ROM: Spin Into Action[/h3][p]Prepare for a blast from the past in the CD-ROM biome. Does anyone still use those? The owner of the computer surely doesn't! Here, the game gets a bit spooky and dangerous because of the lasers and... other things.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/90f0a080cdc0be6513945f7a1bee16d5aef32242.png"][/img][/p][h3]5. Graphics Card: A Feast for the Eyes[/h3][p]The Graphics Card biome dazzles with stunning visuals and creative mechanics. Expect to manipulate light and color as you push your abilities to the limit. It’s a true showcase of Bytebond’s artistic flair.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/f1ccfb2ce407a79bc35ef31f86634c66e7836aee.png"][/img][/p][h3]6. CPU: The Final Showdown[/h3][p]At last, you’ll reach the CPU—the heart of the computer and the core of the infection. This is where all your skills will be put to the test. Only the bravest and most resourceful robots will succeed![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/4c999cabff9897e6f54491b191523df2bd5dd824.png"][/img][/p][p]Until next time [/p][p][b]Bleep & Bloop OUT! ⚡[/b]  [/p][p]───────────────────────────────────────────── [/p][h3]⚡Add Bytebond to your Steam Wishlist⚡[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952690/Bytebond/"][/dynamiclink]───────────────────────────────────────────── [/p][h3]⚡Previous update⚡[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1952690/view/539989391348597279"][/dynamiclink]───────────────────────────────────────────── [/p][h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/AnsharPublishing"][b]🤖 Follow Anshar Publishing on Steam 🤖[/b][/url][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/b21c7265c478a6bdbbfdcb69f1a35d7d19364cdc.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Become a Community Playtester – Play Early, Share Feedback, Earn Rewards!
notes.content: [h2]We’re excited to announce that we’re opening up ​​[b][i]Community Playtests[/i]​​[/b] and we’re looking for [b]brave playtesters[/b] from our amazing community! [/h2][p]This is a chance to help us shape the game before release and get a sneak peek at everything we’ve been working on. [/p][h3]⚠️ Important! [/h3][p][b]You will need a friend to play with[/b]. While there is a way to play Bytebond solo, the game is [b]made to be played in co-op[/b], and we need to playtest it that way. You can play in couch co-op or online, it's up to you. If you don't have anyone to play with, you can still apply — we'll do our best to find you a pair over Discord![/p][h3]🤖 We’re especially looking for your feedback on two key aspects:[/h3][p]1.  ​[b]Controls:[/b]​ Does the steering scheme on controller/keyboard + mouse make sense to you, or do you find it confusing and would like to see changes?[/p][p]2.  ​[b]Pacing & Difficulty:[/b]​ Do the biomes gradually get harder as you progress (as they should), or do you notice some areas are harder and then suddenly easier (which shouldn’t happen)?[/p][p][b]A full playthrough should take about 5-6 hours.[/b] [/p][h3]🤖 As a thank you for your time and feedback, you’ll get:[/h3][p]▶️ Early access to the game[/p][p]▶️ Your name in the credits[/p][p]▶️ Game key of your choice from Anshar Publishing's catalogue​​![/p][p]The drawback? [b]You’ll see the whole game before release and will mostly encounter some bugs we’re still working on and polishing.[/b][/p][h3]🤖 [b]How to join:[/b][/h3][p]1.  Join the [b][url="https://discord.gg/sMFWjmWvaU"]Anshar Publishing server[/url] on Discord[/b].[/p][p]2.  In ​[b]#roles[/b]​, grab yourself the [b]Playtester role[/b].[/p][p]3.  Post “I’m ready to test!” (or something along those lines 😉) in ​[b]#bytebond-feedback[/b]​ and our community manager will send you a key![/p][p][/p][h3]Testing runs until ​​[b][i]August 31st[/i]​​.[/b] [/h3][p]We can’t wait to hear your thoughts and make the game even better together![/p][p][/p][p][b]Bleep & Bloop OUT! ⚡[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952690/Bytebond"][/dynamiclink]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/p][h3][b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/AnsharPublishing?snr=2___"]🎮 Follow us on Steam! 🎮[/url][/b][/h3][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//41215820/b5c9da8d3f49352842d848e05719002e4cd946df.png"][/img][/p]

Whether you’re a fan of narrative adventures, action-packed shooters, or innovative indie gems, you’ll find something to love among the featured titles.[/p][p]We’re incredibly grateful to Untold Tales for organizing this event and for giving us the chance to showcase our game alongside so many inspiring Polish studios. Don’t miss out—visit the event page on Steam and discover your next favourite game, made with love in Poland![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Check out the upcoming titles:[/b] [/h2][p][/p][h3][b]🤖 Bytebond[/b][/h3][p]Looking for a fun way to connect with a friend? Bytebond is a light-hearted two-player game where teamwork and quick thinking are the keys to success! Jump into a colorful cyber world, solve puzzles, and tackle challenges together. It’s all about bonding, bytes, and having a blast—perfect for casual players who love a good co-op adventure![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1952690/Bytebond"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]🗡️ Whispers Of The Eyeless[/b][/h3][p]Become a Prophet in a haunting world where secrets lurk in every shadow. notes.title: New Enemy Tactics and Digital Storms
notes.content: [h2]Greetings, Defenders! 🛡️  [/h2][p]We’ve been hard at work to bring you another wave of awesome updates—and we’re thrilled to show you what’s new in the latest version of Bytebond! Let’s jump in 😉[/p][h3][img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f998.png"][/img] [b]​​Jumping Enemies[/b]​​[/h3][p]We’ve wrapped up work on the last of our bad guy types—the jumper! Not only is this enemy ready to leap into action, but it also received a full VFX overhaul to make encounters even more exciting.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/3caf6f1e7d7e44d110851cc7815402847aaedc45.gif"][/img][/p][h3][img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f329-fe0f.png"][/img] [b]​​Mysterious Storms[/b]​​[/h3][p]A strange digital storm is brewing, playing a key role in our robot’s journey. We don’t want to spoil the surprise, so for now, enjoy the cool VFX—what it all means is for you to discover![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/03f6fbad787dd00df4466f45b8022f686c87f3dd.gif"][/img][/p][h3][img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f5a5-fe0f.png"][/img] [b]​​New Level Decorations[/b]​​[/h3][p]Our levels are looking even more interesting with the addition of old PC monitors, stacks of paper, and GPU racks. Why are these objects inside a computer? You’ll have to play the game to uncover the mystery![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/a72736ae61f51c9b9a2437bf9fe7fe78d5d862a7.png"][/img][/p][h3][img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f41e.png"][/img] ​[b]Bugs (the Cute Kind!)[/b]​[/h3][p]We’re bringing more life to our levels by adding adorable chip-bugs and other little critters. notes.title: ⚔️ Sharper Combat, Smarter Multiplayer & Steam Next Fest Incoming!
notes.content:
Greetings, Defenders! 🛡️

We’ve been hard at work to bring you another wave of awesome updates—and we’re thrilled to show you what’s new in the latest version of Bytebond! Let’s jump in:

🎯 Combat Rework
Fighting off the virus just got a whole lot smoother! We’ve added improved visual feedback to make every hit feel more impactful and revamped targeting to help you lock onto enemies faster and smarter. Suit up and get ready to smash some bugs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/bf7ba17b5279276b78ffc04212d78a2de2c6934a.jpg[/img]

🌐 Public Lobbies Are Here!
Want to jump into a quick game with fellow defenders? Now you can! Public lobby support is live, complete with an in-game server list—making it easier than ever to connect, team up, and dive into the digital frontier together.

🏆 Achievements Unlocked
Twelve brand-new achievements have landed! Explore deeper, play smarter, and show off your accomplishments. Can you unlock them all?

🔧 Online Co-op Enhancements
We’ve made major improvements to network stability for online play—less lag, more fun. Plus, you now have the option to toggle split-screen on or off in online multiplayer. Whether you like to share the screen or go full solo view, the choice is yours!

🎲 Cube Mechanics Overhaul
The trusty cube’s been hitting the gym! You’ll now experience smoother pickup mechanics and more accurate interactions with pressure plates and other objects. No more fumbling—just precision gameplay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/fb2798e5a4f6d2873e043bae5407db223dac937c.png[/img]

🌀 Split-Screen Smoothed Out
When characters move vertically apart, the split-screen transition is now way more graceful. Vertical camera shifts are softer, more cinematic, and less jarring—because your teamwork deserves seamless visuals.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982313/7587a233702ce7a36cd3d795cf0576b2f4b9a7b2.jpg[/img]
🚨 MARK YOUR CALENDAR: Bytebond @ Steam Next Fest!
Big news! Our Bytebond demo will be part of Steam Next Fest from June 9–16!
It’s your chance to try the game, stream it, share feedback, and help shape the future of the project. We can’t wait to see what you think!

Thanks for being part of our growing community—we’re just getting started.
Until next time...

Bleep & Bloop OUT! ⚡
